tuples.title: Positives
tuples.review:
Siolim, located in North Goa is a charming village known for its blend of traditional culture and scenic beauty. Situated, along the banks of Chapora river, it offers a peaceful retreat, away from the bustling tourist hubs yet remain close to popular beaches like Vagator, Anjuna and Morjim.
 One of Siolim's main attractions is its laid-back atmosphere. The village is dotted with traditional Portuguese houses, lush greenery, and narrow winding roads that adds to its old-world charm. For those looking to experience the slower pace of Goan life, Siolim provides the perfect backdrop where locals are friendly, and vibe is relaxed.

tuples.title: Negatives
tuples.review: Siolim, like all of Goa has its limitation of not having good public transportation. One needs to have their own transport in order to roam around comfortably and commute to other places. Taxi rates are on the higher side. There are hardly any app based cab services available in Siolim, like most parts of Goa.

tuples.title: Positives
tuples.review: Firstly this locality has an excellent network of roads and has nearly every convenient way of transportation Here is no issue of traffic,roads are mostly clear 24/7. Cabs and auto are also available whenever needed This makes the locality a better one. Good schools and hospitals are very near to this locality, Roads are well maintained which reduces the risks of accidents. Locality is pretty much safe and secure as there are scarcely any crimes reported nearby

tuples.title: Negatives
tuples.review:
Inspire of being an excellent locality in case of connectivity and security, it has some flaws too which are as follows
Sometimes waste is accumulated in an open area which makes the locality unhygienic and increases the risk of air born diseases. Due to the same reason pollution in this area is also a bit high. And the last negative impact is the shortage of water in the locality. Water is available only at time intervals 
That's all!

tuples.title: Positives
tuples.review: Beautiful calm and quiet village close to the best of beaches, eating joints and also to Mopa airport. Best of schools and hospitals are close by. Self contained market and best of supermarkets. On the banks of Chapora and Anjuna river. Home to a lot of celebrities and a lot of heritage houses. A lot of high end villas so the the area is very peaceful.

tuples.title: Negatives
tuples.review: Honestly speaking there are no negatives of this place. If you are bang on the main road, then perhaps there is a bit of chaos.
